title: THE BRIAN JONESTOWN MASSACRE
tickerText:
THE BRIAN JONESTOWN MASSACRE HAVE SPENT THREE DECADES OPERATING ON THEIR OWN FREQUENCY. FORMED IN SAN FRANCISCO IN THE EARLY ’90S AND DRIVEN BY ANTON NEWCOMBE, THE BAND HAS BUILT A HUGE, RESTLESS BODY OF WORK THAT MOVES THROUGH PSYCHEDELIA, GARAGE ROCK, FOLK, SHOEGAZE, DRONE AND WHATEVER ELSE GETS PULLED INTO THE ORBIT. NEVER PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN PLAYING BY INDUSTRY RULES, BJM HAVE RELEASED MUSIC AT A RELENTLESS PACE WHILE DEVELOPING A CULT FOLLOWING AROUND THE WORLD. THE SOUND CAN BE BEAUTIFUL, RAW, HYPNOTIC, MELODIC OR COMPLETELY UNHINGED—SOMETIMES ALL WITHIN THE SAME RECORD.

DIG.
